import os
import json
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
import lightgbm as lgb

# Suppress progress bars
lgb.set_logfile("/dev/null")
pd.options.mode.chained_assignment = None

# Paths
TRAIN_PATH = "input/labels.csv"
TEST_PATH = "input/test.csv"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "submission"
SAMPLE_SUB_PATH = "input/sample_submission.csv"

os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load training data
print("Loading training data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
train_df = train_df.rename(columns={"fare_amount": "target"})

# Keep only relevant columns
cols_to_use = [
    "pickup_datetime",
    "pickup_latitude",
    "pickup_longitude",
    "dropoff_latitude",
    "dropoff_longitude",
    "passenger_count",
    "key",
]
other_cols = [c for c in cols_to_use if c not in train_df.columns]
for c in other_cols:
    if c in train_df.columns:
        print(f"Found {c} in train")

train_data = train_df[cols_to_use]
train_labels = train_df.loc[train_df.index, ["fare_amount"]]
train_data = train_data.reset_index(drop=True)
train_labels = train_labels.reset_index(drop=True)

# Load test data
print("Loading test data...")
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)

# Sample submission template (get column order)
if os.path.exists(SAMPLE_SUB_PATH):
    sample_sub = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUB_PATH)
else:
    # Default structure
    sample_sub = None

# Merge key info from train if available
if "key" in train_df.columns:
    train_keys = train_df["key"]
else:
    train_keys = []

# Feature Engineering
# Parse datetime
datetime_col = "pickup_datetime"
train_data[f"{datetime_col}_hour"] = pd.to_datetime(train_data[datetime_col]).dt.hour
test_data = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
test_data[f"{datetime_col}_hour"] = pd.to_datetime(test_data[datetime_col]).dt.hour

train_data["day_of_week"] = pd.to_datetime(train_data[datetime_col]).dt.dayofweek
test_data["day_of_week"] = pd.to_datetime(test_data[datetime_col]).dt.dayofweek

train_data["pickup_dropoff_diff_lat"] = abs(train_data["pickup_latitude"]) + abs(
    train_data["dropoff_latitude"]
)
train_data["pickup_dropoff_diff_lon"] = abs(train_data["pickup_longitude"]) + abs(
    train_data["dropoff_longitude"]
)
train_data["distance"] = np.sqrt(
    train_data["pickup_dropoff_diff_lat"] ** 2
    + train_data["pickup_dropoff_diff_lon"] ** 2
)

test_data["pickup_dropoff_diff_lat"] = abs(test_data["pickup_latitude"]) + abs(
    test_data["dropoff_latitude"]
)
test_data["pickup_dropoff_diff_lon"] = abs(test_data["pickup_longitude"]) + abs(
    test_data["dropoff_longitude"]
)
test_data["distance"] = np.sqrt(
    test_data["pickup_dropoff_diff_lat"] ** 2
    + test_data["pickup_dropoff_diff_lon"] ** 2
)

# Combine features
feature_cols = [
    "pickup_datetime_hour",
    "day_of_week",
    "pickup_dropoff_diff_lat",
    "pickup_dropoff_diff_lon",
    "distance",
    "passenger_count",
]

X_train_raw = train_data[feature_cols]
X_test_raw = test_data[feature_cols]

# Fill NaN values
X_train_raw = X_train_raw.fillna(0)
X_test_raw = X_test_raw.fillna(0)

# Split into train/validation for evaluation (held out, not refitted later)
print("Creating held-out validation split...")
X_train_scaled, X_val_scaled, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_raw.values.astype(np.float32),
    train_labels["fare_amount"].values.astype(np.float32),
    test_size=0.15,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=np.random.RandomState().choice,
)

# Fit scaler on training data only
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train_final = scaler.fit_transform(X_train_scaled)
X_val_final = scaler.transform(X_val_scaled)
X_test_final = scaler.transform(X_test_raw.values.astype(np.float32))

print("Training LightGBM model...")
params = {
    "objective": "regression",
    "metric": "rmse",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "min_child_samples": 20,
    "max_depth": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
}

train_set = lgb.Dataset(X_train_final, label=y_train, feature_name=feature_cols)
valid_set = lgb.Dataset(X_val_final, label=y_val, reference=train_set)

model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_set,
    num_boost_round=1000,
    valid_sets=[valid_set],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(50), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
)

# Evaluate on held-out validation set (genuine estimate)
print("Evaluating on validation set...")
y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val_final, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
validation_rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_val, y_val_pred))
print(f"Held-out Validation RMSE: {validation_rmse:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
print("Predicting on test set...")
test_predictions = model.predict(X_test_final)
test_df["predicted_fare"] = test_predictions

# Save to submission.csv
print("Saving submission...")
if sample_sub is not None:
    # Use sample template structure
    submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
        {"key": test_df["key"], "fare_amount": test_predictions}
    )
else:
    submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
        {"key": test_df["key"], "fare_amount": test_predictions}
    )

# Sort by key
submission_df = submission_df.sort_values("key").reset_index(drop=True)
submission_df["fare_amount"] = submission_df["fare_amount"].round(2)
submission_df.to_csv(os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv"), index=False)

print(f"\nFinal submission saved to {SUBMISSION_DIR}/submission.csv")
print(f"Held-out validation RMSE: {validation_rmse:.6f}")
